## The Union Bound {#union}

<iframe class="widget-frame" src="widgets/union_widget.html" title="Union bound widget" scrolling="no"></iframe>

<p class="widget-open"><a href="widgets/union_widget.html">Open in its own page</a></p>

<script>
(function () {
  function fit(frame) {
    var doc;
    try { doc = frame.contentDocument; } catch (e) { return; }
    if (!doc || !doc.documentElement) return;
    var h = Math.ceil(doc.documentElement.getBoundingClientRect().height);
    if (h > 0) frame.style.height = (h + 2) + 'px';
  }
  function watch(frame) {
    fit(frame);
    var win;
    try { win = frame.contentWindow; } catch (e) { return; }
    if (win && win.ResizeObserver) {
      new win.ResizeObserver(function () { fit(frame); }).observe(win.document.documentElement);
    }
  }
  var frames = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('iframe.widget-frame'));
  frames.forEach(function (frame) {
    frame.addEventListener('load', function () { watch(frame); });
    var doc = null;
    try { doc = frame.contentDocument; } catch (e) {}
    if (doc && doc.readyState === 'complete' && doc.location.href !== 'about:blank') watch(frame);
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { frames.forEach(fit); });
})();
</script>
